headline: Petition to bring Huang back to Nvidia grows with Musk's backing
dek: The push began inside the company and gained big names, per TechCrunch and CNBC.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: What happened
body: The "Stand with Jensen" petition asks for Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO, per TechCrunch and CNBC Technology.
It grew from 115,000 signatures on Saturday to nearly 180,000 on Monday (CNBC Technology).

points.t: Elon Musk said on X that he signed the petition.
Garry Tan and Tim Sweeney confirmed support.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Why it matters
body: The push is no longer internal; it is now public pressure on Nvidia's board.
The text asks the board to bring him back while an independent investigation establishes the facts (TechCrunch).

items.t: Colette Kress stays interim CEO (CNBC Technology).
The board seeks internal and external candidates.

caption.hook: The petition to bring Jensen Huang back to Nvidia now has nearly 180,000 signatures.
body: Per TechCrunch and CNBC Technology, the "Stand with Jensen" petition grew from 115,000 signatures on Saturday to nearly 180,000 on Monday. Elon Musk said on X that he signed it, and Garry Tan and Tim Sweeney also confirmed their support, according to both outlets.

The petition's text says it is concerned that Huang was removed without due process and asks the board to bring him back while an independent investigation establishes the facts. Nvidia is keeping Colette Kress as interim CEO, and the board continues the investigation and the search for a permanent CEO, per both outlets. A spokesperson said no candidate has been engaged.
caption.cta: Should Nvidia's board reconsider Huang's exit?
